title: Substation
description: Supplemental attribute representing a substation that groups node buses and switching devices of a full-topology (node-breaker) network model. Attach the attribute to every member component. Geospatial data is not stored here; attach a GeographicInfo attribute to the member components instead.

number.description: Substation number in the source power flow data

grounding_resistance.description: Substation grounding DC resistance. Units: ohm.
